comments.text:
Starting at 4:30, huh.
All right, let's get a little sleep!! Don't you worry about oversleeping!! See you at 4:30!!
I woke up. I have awakened!
Well then, let's do this again this week!
Last time, he didn't die.
Whose house in Arlam Village do you suppose this is?
A truly compelling performance!
The conditions for lifting this curse are a little different from usual. Clap clap clap.
Opening!
Just like you saw in the preview, this week's episode moves like crazy, so look forward to it. Seriously, it's on an insane level.
It should be about time everyone started properly realizing that the lineup at the end is not Subaru's harem...!
Pack gag again
Part A starts now---!
Ram is cute this week too, so keep an eye on her.
This is an episode where nee-sama's charms come through really strongly.
A mabeast has appeared, so the villagers are in an emergency meeting. You could also call it waiting for Roswaal.
The protagonist casually going in for a touch on Petra...
Rare outdoor Beako
By the way, according to the setting, the steamed potatoes Ram made aren't potatoes, but a tuber called "yam potato."

It's refreshing to see Beako standing on bare earth. It looks like her skirt is dragging on the ground, but the hem repels dirt and such with magic power. A long time ago, I saw a setting note saying Lulu from FF10 did the same thing, so we're using something like that here.
The cold open returns
Nee-sama happened to overhear them while searching through the village. Was she really just overhearing? Maybe she was worried about Beako and Subaru's conversation.
Is it just the author's bias, or does Subaru basically look cuter whenever he's gotten something off his chest?
The sky is unbelievably beautiful
Part A over! Wasn't that fast?
It was mentioned so casually, but there's going to be an official anthology comic! Isn't that amazing? Isn't that amazing?
What a nonstop barrage of Re:Zero commercials!
Now then, enjoy the perfectly great Part B!
The finest blade in the village, the "Destiny Blade"...! (A name I made up myself)
I guess it's a rhinoceros beetle
Kobayashi-san fulfills the ikemen-voice quota
Anyone with an eye for it will spot Ram's clairvoyance immediately, but it was inspired by the vision-jacking effect from the game Siren.
Every mabeast gives priority to targeting Subaru. The reason is that he looks weak. Also, he looks easy to mess with.
A scene that steps a little into the deeper parts of those two. The explanatory dialogue has been changed slightly from the original.
Rem going wild in the forest moves an absurd amount
I wrote a ton in the second bonus booklet about Ram and Rem's stance on the whole horn issue. It's probably super interesting! (Shameless promotion)
Thanks to the battle right before this, Subaru-kun is rating Ram's combat ability pretty highly in his head.
This is the part from the preview where Rem reacted to Subaru's butt.
You might be wondering why the mabeasts haven't caught up here, but it's because they're toying with Subaru and the others, so they're deliberately not catching up.
The Destiny Blade breaks
Ram's face when she's sliding down just now is one she almost never shows, so if you watch it in slow motion, it's cute desu.
The boss Guiltylowe waiting behind the pack
And once again this week, a hero appears when the heroine is in trouble! This time, a dark hero.
Please pay close attention to Rem's movements from here on.
While Rem buys time for him, Subaru tries to put a little distance between them. But he's badly outnumbered.
He draws the enemies focused only on Rem over to himself by revealing "Return by Death." But it also draws Rem's attention.
Rem trying to kill the dogs and the staff
He throws it farther than expected here
Nee-sama's face while she's flying is surreal
The boss Guiltylowe pulled the attention from above downward. In other words, it was a joint effort by the two of them.
Part B over!! On to the ending!!

Did you know? This is actually the first time since episode 2 that both the OP and ED are here together. And back then, the ending didn't have visuals to avoid spoilers! This is the completed version! This is proper anime!
Wow, though, today was especially early.
It begins with mabeast sponsor cards and ends with mabeast sponsor cards. ...Oh, wait, Pack isn't a mabeast!
Still, Rem's movements were incredible. Really, all I can say is thank you so much. It was amazing.

Oh right, the scene showing how Rem, who was so active today, first met Mr. Iron Ball is in volume 2 of the bonus novel. It turned out very romantic and fateful, so please give it a read. Go on, here you are!
